name: pager
description: Pager: Claude Code pings you in Telegram when a task is done or it waits for your permission, and you text back the next prompt, /status, /last or /stop from your phone

botToken.title: Telegram bot token
botToken.description: The token @BotFather gave you (1234567890:AA...). Kept in secure storage. You can also set it later with /pager token <token>

minSeconds.title: Notify after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Send 'done' only for turns that took at least this long, so quick answers you watched yourself do not buzz your phone. A turn started from Telegram is always reported

notifyPermission.title: Notify when waiting
notifyPermission.description: Send a message when Claude waits for your permission or input

acceptPrompts.title: Accept prompts from Telegram
acceptPrompts.description: Text the bot to queue the next prompt in this session (only the paired chat is listened to)

desktop.title: Desktop notification too
desktop.description: Also raise a system notification on this computer when a task is done
